_note: Booking-draft tool (2026-10-20 extension pack). core.mjs TOOLS shape. Returns text; sends nothing, books nothing.

tools.description: Draft a booking/enquiry email for a place+programme+dates: fills the centre's own booking instructions (registration links, check-in rules, contacts) into polite text the user sends themselves. Never sends, never books, never holds payment. Includes the schedule checked-date so the user re-confirms.
tools.name: compose_booking
tools.resolver: place.contact + programme.schedule_url + check-in rules + checked dates -> email text + links; refusals when contacts missing (direct user to the official page instead)
tools.title: Draft a booking
